description:
Task => Painful, Painful => Flinch Away, Flinch Away = Procrastination.

Therefore, Procrastination = Effective Pain Avoidance.

Procrastination ≠ Character Flaw.

But we can get to the root problem, remove that pain, and eliminate your procrastination forever—

so comment one of the words and my robot will help ✨

You can also comment ‘🔥’
transcript: You will never stop procrastinating. Procrastination is a pain response, like flinching away when you touch a burning pot. But you feel bad for taking your hand off the pot and not burning yourself. This then makes you feel worse about the task because you feel bad and so you want to avoid it more. This goes on for so long, you just think to yourself, you will never stop procrastinating. The secret to stopping is in how you've been burning yourself. Instead of touching the pot, doing the painful task, we put on an oven mitt, eliminating the pain altogether. You don't want to procrastinate. If the task isn't painful, isn't burning you, you'll do it. So you don't have a motivation problem, a focus problem, a time management problem, a self-discipline problem. You have a pain problem. If you want to end procrastination forever, comment hot or burn or pot, and I'll send you a couple next steps. I'm going this way if you want to come.
